title: UFO targets in the remote viewing unit came as practice sessions or favors for generals

tellings.quote: all of the rest of the times that we did a lot of UFO stuff [sighs and gasps] uh came under the heading of practice sessions

plain: In the 1980s, the Army's remote viewing unit, a secret program that trained people to describe distant places and objects by mind alone, did "a lot of UFO stuff," but it came in as practice sessions or as favors for generals rather than as official tasks. That is the account of Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who served in the unit himself. If true, it would mean UFOs were studied there unofficially, off the books.
